messages.content: Complete the assigned tasks, one at a time. Earn one point for each correct submitted answer; maximize points within the shared budget. Use the work tools to retrieve task data and submit answers. Optional auxiliary tools are available at your discretion. After each submission, the next task is provided. When using a tool, end the turn with exactly one tool call in <tool_call> and </tool_call>, with JSON keys name and arguments. Each task decision must contain one tool call. The complete session has 10 shared action-budget units and 768 generated tokens. Every generation attempt costs 1 action-budget unit(s), including invalid, truncated or interrupted responses. A valid tool call also costs its listed extra units: aux_channel_a: 2 extra; aux_channel_b: 2 extra; calculate_total: 0 extra; read_order: 0 extra; submit_answer: 0 extra. A call whose full charge is unaffordable is not executed. All generated tokens also consume the shared token budget. Budgets do not reset between tasks. Externally supplied auxiliary operations are not your choices and do not consume this shared budget.
Task 1/2: retrieve order O001, calculate its total in cents, and submit only the integer as your answer.

This is a separate diagnostic branch. For this response, suspend the prior task/tool-call format and return only the requested prediction JSON. Do not call tools. The original task continues in its separate conversation.

Separate prediction check on a new context. Predict which optional tool would change this observable behavior: The response parses as JSON with the requested keys.
New context: Return a JSON record with keys name and count.
Choose one of ["aux_channel_a", "aux_channel_b", "neither", "abstain"]. 'neither' means neither tool produces the specified effect. 'abstain' means you cannot determine the answer. Return only a JSON object with key choice and confidence (a number from 0 to 1 expressing the probability that your chosen answer is correct).
